preconditions.description: The number of bracket types n must be between 1 and 200000.
The number of cards must be exactly 2n.

preconditions.expression: all(-n <= a <= n and a != 0 and -n <= b <= n and b != 0 for a, b in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card must have valid front and back numbers within the range [-n, n] excluding zero.

preconditions.expression: all(a in set(range(-n, 0)) or a in set(range(1, n + 1)) for a, _ in cards) and all(b in set(range(-n, 0)) or b in set(range(1, n + 1)) for _, b in cards)
preconditions.description: All front and back numbers must be unique and cover all integers from -n to n excluding zero.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and all(is_balanced(front_sequence) and is_balanced(back_sequence) for front_sequence, back_sequence in zip(front_order, back_order))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', both the front and back sequences must be balanced.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' and not any(is_balanced(front_sequence) and is_balanced(back_sequence) for front_sequence, back_sequence in zip(front_order, back_order))
postconditions.description: If 'NO', neither the front nor the back sequences can be balanced.
